modules.title: 一台电脑怎样同时运行网页和接口服务
地址里的端口负责什么

items.title: 主机先定位设备
items.text: `localhost` 指向你正在使用的电脑，部署后的域名则定位到可公开访问的服务器；它本身不说明服务是哪一个。

items.title: 端口再定位服务
items.text: 冒号后的数字把请求交给对应服务。若开发服务器提示 3001 已被占用或自动换到 3002，浏览器地址也必须随之更新。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 端口不是网址域名，也不是“上线开关”。`localhost:3000` 只能由当前电脑访问；即使端口正确，别人也无法借此打开你的本地项目。端口占用是同一入口冲突，不等同于代码报错。

lessonPractice.title: 终端显示网页已运行在 `http://localhost:3001`，但你仍打开 `localhost:3000` 并看到旧页面。先做什么？

options.label: 按终端地址打开 3001，并确认 3000 当前由哪个本地服务提供旧页面
options.feedback: 对。localhost 是同一台电脑，端口才决定你连到哪项服务。

options.label: 继续打开 3000，反复重启当前项目，直到旧页面被新页面替换
options.feedback: 当前项目已经明确监听 3001；重启不能保证另一个占用 3000 的服务消失。

options.label: 让网页服务同时监听 3000 和 3001，保证两个地址都显示同一页面
options.feedback: 这会绕开而不是解释冲突，也可能抢占另一个服务正在使用的端口；应先确认每个端口对应谁。

en.title: The terminal says the page is running at `http://localhost:3001`, but you keep opening `localhost:3000` and see an old page. What should you do first?

options.label: Open port 3001 as reported, then identify which local service is still serving the old page on 3000
options.feedback: Correct. localhost is the same device; the port decides which service you reach.

options.label: Keep opening port 3000 and restart the current project until the new page replaces the old one
options.feedback: The current project already reports port 3001. Restarting it does not guarantee that the other service using 3000 disappears.

options.label: Make the page service listen on both 3000 and 3001 so both addresses show the same page
options.feedback: That avoids rather than explains the conflict and may take a port another service uses. First identify which service owns each port.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在项目终端运行 `npm run dev`，把终端输出的完整本地地址发给我。若 3000 被占用，请说明最终使用的端口；然后分别打开网页和接口地址，确认它们没有连错服务。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Run `npm run dev` in the project terminal and show me the complete local address from its output. If port 3000 is occupied, state the final port; then open the page and API addresses separately to confirm they reach the intended services.

learning.assumes: You have run a local project in a terminal or seen an address such as localhost:3000.
learning.outcome: You can identify the host and port in an address and check the target when two local services run together.

modules.title: How one computer runs a page and API together
What the port in an address does

items.title: The host identifies a machine
items.text: `localhost` identifies the computer you are using, while a deployed domain identifies a publicly reachable server. It does not identify a particular service by itself.

items.title: The port identifies the service
items.text: The number after the colon directs the request to that service. If a dev server reports 3001 as occupied or switches to 3002, the browser address must change too.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A port is not a domain name or a deployment switch. `localhost:3000` is reachable only on this computer; a correct port does not make a local project public. A port conflict means two services want the same entry, not necessarily that application code failed.
